categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Trusted Digital Identity and Smart Transportation. The Trusted Digital Identity segment focuses on secure credential production, identity verification, and digital identity management solutions for government and enterprise clients. The Smart Transportation segment provides intelligent public transit solutions including payment terminals, scheduling, and operational management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-end secure credential manufacturing with multi-layer personalization (MLP) anti-counterfeiting processes, AI, IoT, AIOT, blockchain, biometric recognition, RFID, cloud computing, and quantum encryption. The company develops integrated hardware and software solutions, including intelligent terminals, secure card production equipment, and digital identity credential products, supported by a robust R&D system with innovation labs and a focus on AI-enabled product upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies, public security, immigration, transportation authorities, financial institutions, and enterprises requiring secure identity management and smart transit solutions. Major markets include domestic Chinese government sectors and overseas markets along the Belt and Road countries, Southeast Asia, Africa, Middle East, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive domestic coverage across 31 provinces and over 200 cities for smart transportation. It has a growing international presence with projects and subsidiaries in countries such as Burkina Faso, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Nepal, Singapore, and regions including Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, Africa, Middle East, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing secure credential production equipment, intelligent terminals, and providing integrated solutions and services for identity management and smart transportation. It controls product design, manufacturing, system integration, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI-driven product innovation, upgrading secure credential technologies, expanding overseas markets with localized solutions, and building an ecosystem around digital identity and smart transportation. R&D focuses on AI, big data, quantum encryption, multi-modal biometric recognition, and autonomous intelligent terminals, with significant investment in innovation labs and patent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of secure credential equipment, intelligent terminals, and digital identity products, as well as software and integrated system solutions. The company also earns from service contracts, operational management platforms, and strategic overseas projects, with a mix of direct sales and channel distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the global leaders in secure credential personalization equipment, ranked third worldwide, competing with firms like Entrust and HID from the US, and German companies such as Nüba and Ruhlamat. It holds a unique position as the only Chinese company listed in the ICAO machine-readable travel document equipment supplier directory, with strong brand recognition and extensive overseas project experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 552 million, a 33.93% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 29.15 million, a 223.78% increase, marking a turnaround to profitability. Total assets reached RMB 1.34 billion, with steady growth in equity and a gross margin of 43.65%. The company maintains a robust R&D investment at over 19% of revenue and continues expanding its international footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced multi-layer personalization (MLP) anti-counterfeiting technology, AI-enabled intelligent terminals, and comprehensive end-to-end digital identity solutions that integrate hardware, software, and services. Its products offer high security, customization, and compliance with international standards, enabling trusted identity verification and smart transportation management. The company’s global project experience and localized solutions provide competitive differentiation in both domestic and international markets.
